info.title: GuestPilot API
info.description: REST API for GuestPilot Mobile Apps & Webhooks

restaurantId.description: The organisation (id or slug) the guest is signing up at — where a friend’s referral is rewarded. Default: the first organisation served

email.description: The address a verification code was sent to.

accessToken.description: A JWT, sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`. Short-lived.

refreshToken.description: Single-use: `POST /auth/refresh-token` exchanges it for the next pair.

referralCode.description: A friend’s referral code. Used only when this sign-in creates the account; ignored for an existing one

restaurantId.description: The organisation (id or slug) the guest is signing up at — where a friend’s referral is rewarded. Default: the first organisation served

code.description: The code sent to the email address; `""` once the email is verified and only the SMS code is left

smsCode.description: The code sent by SMS to the phone. Required until the phone is verified

message.description: What was done, in a sentence.

deviceToken.description: This phone's push token, so it stops receiving this account's pushes once signed out

average.description: The average of every guest’s stars, to one decimal.

count.description: How many guests have rated it.

state.description: `closed`: the week is stored and today has no hours.

close.description: With `hours`: when it closes; earlier than `open` runs past midnight.

openNow.description: With `hours`: whether it is open at the moment of the answer.

internalName.description: The operator’s own name for it — the fallback when `name` has no language to show.

id.description: The `branchId` every basket, quote and order call takes.

internalName.description: The POS’s own title — the fallback when `name` has no language to show.

district.description: The part of the city it is in — for grouping and filtering branch lists.

description.description: One line about the place, written by the merchant — the design’s branch card.

acceptsTips.description: The app may offer a tip here: the organisation records tips at its POS. Send `tip` on POST /orders only when true.

rating.description: Guests’ stars: the average and how many gave them; `null` when nobody has rated it.

today.description: Today’s hours on the location’s own clock, and whether it is open now; `null` when no week is stored.

timezone.description: An IANA zone — the one its hours are in.

openingHours.description: When the place is open, by weekday, for display. Null when nobody has entered them.

orderingEnabled.description: Whether it takes orders at all.

takesAppOrders.description: False: this location does not take orders from the app. Show its menu; offer no basket.

brand.description: The name over the door, for grouping.

distanceKm.description: Only when the list was asked with `lat` and `lng` and the location has coordinates.

rating.description: Stars, a whole number from 1 to 5.

text.description: What the guest wants to say — read by the merchant, shown to no other guest. Empty is none.
What the guest wrote; `null` when nothing.

internalName.description: The POS’s own title — the fallback when `name` has no language to show.

description.description: What the operator wrote about it.

name.description: The POS’s own name, in one language.

label.description: Its name in the request’s language.

minQuantity.description: On a group: how many options the guest must choose. 0 or absent: optional.

maxQuantity.description: On a group: how many they may choose. 1 is a radio group. Absent: no limit.

defaultQuantity.description: On an option: above 0, pre-select it.

id.description: What `modifiers: [{ id }]` on an add takes.

name.description: The POS’s own name; translations are in the item’s `optionNames`.

price.description: What choosing it adds to the dish, per unit.

kind.description: `size`: the dish’s sizes (Small / Regular / Large), one required choice — each option’s `price` is that size above the smallest, which is the item’s `price`. Absent on an ordinary group of options.

internalName.description: The POS’s own title — the fallback when `name` has no language to show.

description.description: What the operator wrote about it.

galleryImages.description: Absolute URLs. Empty when there are none.

isFeatured.description: The merchant marked it for the app’s *Featured products* rail.

portion.description: How much one portion is, from the POS — the design’s *300 ml*. `null`: the kitchen entered none.

modifiersJson.description: The groups of options. Empty: the dish has none.

price.description: What it costs at this location. A whole number of the currency.

isAvailable.description: False: the kitchen has stopped it here. Show it greyed; the basket refuses it.

unavailableModifiers.description: Ids of options this location has run out of.

optionNames.description: Translations of group and option names, by id. Only ids that have one appear.

description.description: What the operator wrote about it.

id.description: The line — what `PUT`/`DELETE /cart/items/{id}` take. Not the item.

unitPrice.description: One unit with its options. A whole number of the currency.

modifierPrice.description: The options’ part of `unitPrice` — already included. A whole number of the currency.

total.description: `unitPrice × quantity`. A whole number of the currency.

modifiersJson.description: What was chosen. Null when nothing was.

item.description: The dish, enough to draw the line.

available.description: Whether the line can still be ordered at this location. `false`: an order is refused `cart_items_unavailable` until it is removed.

unavailableReason.description: Why not — the code adding that line now would be refused with. `null` when `available`.

id.description: Null when no basket is stored here yet.

total.description: The sum of the lines, as the guest was shown them. Checkout reads prices again. A whole number of the currency.

itemId.description: Item ID to add to cart

branchId.description: Location ID — every order must belong to a specific location (PRD §4.3)

modifiers.description: The options the guest chose, as `[{ id }]` — option ids from the item’s `modifiersJson[].items[].id`, one entry per option. Names and prices are the server’s: anything else sent is ignored. Omit it for an item with no options, or when nothing is chosen from optional groups.

branchId.description: Target location ID — existing cart will be abandoned (PRD §4.3)

loyaltyPointsToSpend.description: Do not send. Any value above 0 is refused with 400 — points are spent through walletToSpend, as part of the one amount the POS quotes

walletToSpend.description: The amount to apply from the guest’s balances, in currency: any figure up to `maxRedeemable` from POST /loyalty/calculate-redemption. Covers every balance kind, points included. More than the POS will cover is applied in part, never refused — read `walletSpent` on the answer

tip.description: The guest’s tip, in whole currency, charged with the order — the design’s 100 / 200 / 300 / other. Only where the location answers `acceptsTips`; no more than the basket. Omit or 0 for none

branchId.description: Location the guest is checking out at; the basket must be there

itemId.description: Null when the item has since left the menu.

name.description: The dish’s name as it was when ordered, in the language the order was placed in.

unitPrice.description: One unit with its options. A whole number of the currency.

modifierPrice.description: The options’ part of `unitPrice`. A whole number of the currency.

total.description: `unitPrice × quantity`. A whole number of the currency.

status.description: Where the order is — `FLOWS.md` §5.2. Show an unknown one as in progress.

scheduledAt.description: When it is wanted for; null for as soon as possible.

guestName.description: The contact given on this order.

guestPhone.description: The contact given on this order.

guestEmail.description: The contact given on this order.

comment.description: What the guest wrote to the kitchen.

itemsTotal.description: The lines, before anything is taken off. A whole number of the currency.

discount.description: What the POS took off. A whole number of the currency.

walletSpent.description: What was paid from the guest’s balance. A whole number of the currency.

walletReturned.description: What the order gave back to that balance. A whole number of the currency.

totalToCharge.description: What the card was, or will be, charged. A whole number of the currency.

tipAmount.description: The guest’s tip, inside `totalToCharge`; 0 for none. A whole number of the currency.

paymentProvider.description: The gateway it is paid through.

posNumber.description: The number the till calls out.

paymentFormUrl.description: The page to open. Absent — with no `paymentForm` — means there is nothing to pay.

itemsTotal.description: The lines, before anything is taken off. A whole number of the currency.

discount.description: What the POS took off. A whole number of the currency.

walletSpent.description: What was paid from the guest’s balance. A whole number of the currency.

walletReturned.description: What the order gave back to that balance. A whole number of the currency.

totalToCharge.description: What the card was charged. A whole number of the currency.

tipAmount.description: The guest’s tip, inside `totalToCharge`; 0 for none. A whole number of the currency.

limit.description: Orders per page — as asked, from 1 to 50; 20 when not asked

totalPages.description: Pages in all — at least 1, even with no orders

id.description: The POS’s id for the category.
The POS’s id for the wallet — what `split[].walletIds` and a gift’s `walletId` name.

kind.description: What it holds: money, a certificate, items.

balance.description: In the wallet’s own units: currency, or a count of items.

tier.description: The guest’s tier as the POS names it; null when it names none.

sku.description: The POS’s article for the product.

posName.description: The POS’s own name for it.

item.description: The catalogue item, when it is on this menu.

costPerUse.description: How many one free item costs.

claimable.description: How many free items that comes to.

qr.description: A QR of the card number, as a PNG data URI.

cardNumber.description: The number itself — a till without a scanner has it typed.

qrDataUrl.description: A QR of the link, as a PNG data URI.

phone.description: The friend’s phone; the local form (091…) is accepted.
The number the SMS went to, in E.164.

qrDataUrl.description: A QR of the link, as a PNG data URI.

branchId.description: Location the guest is checking out at; the basket quoted is the one there

step.description: 1: by the currency unit. Above 1: in multiples (the price of one item). 0: whole or not at all.

walletIds.description: The wallets it is taken from, as `GET /loyalty/balance` names them.

maxRedeemable.description: The most the POS will let this guest put towards this basket. A whole number of the currency.

grantedDiscount.description: What the POS takes off whether or not the guest redeems anything. A whole number of the currency.

split.description: Where an amount lands, in the POS’s fill order.

expiring.description: How much of it expires on `expiryDate`.

amount.description: Top-up amount: a whole number of AMD from 500 to 500000

paymentProvider.description: Payment gateway to pay through; the first one offered when omitted

success.description: Present when the gateway needed no page: how the top-up went.

paymentFormUrl.description: The page to open, for a gateway reached by a link.

code.description: The refusal’s code, when there is something to say.

error.description: Its sentence, in the request’s language.

id.description: Stable for a top-up from the moment it is started.

type.description: Value in, or value out towards an order.

amount.description: How much moved. A whole number of the currency.

reference.description: A top-up’s own number, or the gift a credit came from. Null on a spend.

orderId.description: The order a spend paid towards.

city.description: The city the guest gave, free text.

photoUrl.description: The guest’s photo, absolute; `null` when none.

language.description: The language every notification to this guest is written in.

hasPassword.description: Whether the account has a password. False for a guest who signed up with a one-time code: they sign in that way, and there is no password to change — hide the form

city.description: City, free text; empty clears it

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth, `YYYY-MM-DD` — a real day, not in the future; `null` clears it

language.description: Interface language code (e.g. hy, en, ru)

phone.description: Phone number — EDIT DISABLED in MVP (PRD §2.4)

signOutOtherDevices.description: Sign out of every other device — the other phones and every browser. Default true. When true the caller is signed out too, and the answer carries the replacement pair.

accessToken.description: The replacement pair, when every session was ended (signOutOtherDevices). Absent otherwise.

branchId.description: Location ID to set as preferred

favoriteItemIds.description: Item ids — resolve them against the menu already held.

token.description: What the phone itself registered — a client finds its own row by it.

lastUsedAt.description: When a push last used it.

formUrl.description: The page to open to enter the card.

saved.description: Present when the gateway needed no page: whether the card was saved.

orderId.description: The gateway's reference for one of your pending orders — `gatewayOrderId` on the order, not its own id

enabled.description: Whether the merchant is taking orders at all. Off, every order is refused `ordering_disabled`; a location’s own switches are on the location.

redemption.description: Whether an amount of balance can be applied at checkout — either module is on.

providers.description: The gateways to offer, in the operator’s order.

default.description: What an order with no `paymentProvider` is paid through.

instant.description: Gateways with no payment page — paid on choosing them. Never a real one.

siteName.description: The merchant’s name, set in Super Admin — the website’s header

quantity.description: How much of the wallet’s own unit: currency, or a count of items.

amount.description: What the sender was charged. A whole number of the currency.

resolvedAt.description: When it was accepted, declined or expired.

recipientName.description: Who it is for, as the sender wrote it.

recipientPhone.description: The phone it was sent to.

acceptWindowDays.description: How long a gift waits for its answer.

unitPrice.description: What one of it costs here. A whole number of the currency.

title.description: The voucher card’s name, as the merchant wrote it; `null` — show `name`.

imageUrl.description: The voucher card’s picture, absolute: the merchant’s, else the first dish the programme covers.

name.description: Their first name; `null` when they have given none — show the number.

surname.description: Their last name; `null` when they have given none.

branchId.description: Location the gift is for — it is priced there and spent at its organisation

walletId.description: A wallet id from GET /api/v1/gifts/options for the same branchId

quantity.description: How much: an amount of currency for a `money` wallet, a number of items for an `items` one. What it costs must be from 500 to 500,000 AMD, as a top-up — else `gift_amount_out_of_range`

recipientPhone.description: The friend’s phone. They must already have an account

recipientName.description: What to call them in the messages about this gift

paymentProvider.description: Payment gateway to pay through; the default when omitted

amount.description: What will be charged. A whole number of the currency.

success.description: Present when the gateway needed no page: how the purchase went.

code.description: The code of what there is to say, when there is something.

message.description: Something to show the guest, in the request’s language.

type.description: `item` — open the dish; `category` — open the menu on it; `url` — open in the browser.

target.description: The item’s or category’s id, or the web address.

title.description: What the tile is — its accessible text.

imageUrl.description: The picture, absolute. 512:264 in the design.

slides.description: The pictures it plays, in order, absolute. At least one.

seen.description: This guest watched it since it last changed. Always `false` without a token — keep the mark on the phone then.

updatedAt.description: When the merchant last changed it.

title.description: As the push showed it, in the guest’s language at the time.

data.description: The push’s `data` — route a tap by it exactly as a push (guide §6.2). `{}` when none.

unread.description: How many of all of them are unread — the bell’s badge.

field.description: The property as it was sent.

message.description: A sentence for this field, in the request’s language.

name.description: The dish, in the language of the request.

reason.description: Why — the code adding that line now would be refused with.

code.description: **What happened — the contract.** It does not change with the wording or the language; branch on it. Every code is listed in `docs/mobile/FLOWS.md` §9.

message.description: One sentence for the guest, in the language `Accept-Language` asked for. Always a string.

errors.description: Only with `code: validation_failed`: one entry per broken rule.

lines.description: Only with `code: cart_items_unavailable`: the basket lines the order was refused for. Remove them (`DELETE /cart/items/{id}`) and order again.
